retrievalProfile.description: A dense, multi-layered urban collage featuring a central figure with outstretched arms, ransom-note style lettering, and a teal-on-black color scheme.
triggerTerms: teal square background with black border
excludeWhen: single-subject photography without overlays is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A complex digital scrapbook composition centered on a teal square, featuring a central male figure in a black jacket with arms wide, surrounded by disparate urban elements like money, doves, and a CD, all framed by a textured black damask-patterned border.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure anchored against a vibrant teal square
Ransom-note typography floating at the top edge of the teal frame
Layered secondary imagery including a child, money, and a CD overlapping the central figure
High-contrast black textured border framing the internal teal composition
coreInvariants: Ransom-note style cutout lettering for the primary title
Distressed halftone and paper-tear textures on all photo elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central male figure occupies the middle third, arms extending horizontally to the edges of the teal square.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The teal square acts as the primary container, while the central figure's torso provides the vertical axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the ransom-note title, move down the central figure, and then spiral outward to the peripheral collage elements like the child and the CD.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense, with negative space primarily existing in the black textured border.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red and Gold (shoes, chain, and CD highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation teal against low-value black, with desaturated halftone photos.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mixed sans-serif and serif block letters
letterConstructionRules: Each letter must appear as a separate physical cutout
Varying background colors for each letter block (brown, blue, grey)
Intentional misalignment and varying heights between adjacent characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are contained within rectangular 'scraps' of paper with rough edges
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Chaotic ransom-note display text paired with a clean, wide-tracked sans-serif for metadata.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dense urban collage on a teal square background with a black damask border. Include a central figure with arms out, a CD, money, and halftone textures.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply ransom-note style lettering for the main title at the top and a clean, wide-spaced sans-serif subtitle at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Do the letters look like individual paper cutouts?
Is the bottom text widely tracked?
Are halftone textures visible on the photos?

mustRedesign: Do not use existing brand logos
Ensure all text is original and not copied from the source

mustAchieve: Balanced chaos in the collage layout

postGenerationChecks: Verify teal and black color balance
Ensure halftone texture is applied to photos
Confirm wide tracking on the bottom subtitle
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Collage = (Teal Square + Black Damask Border) + (Central Figure with Outstretched Arms) + (Ransom Note Typography) + (Halftone Photo Overlays)
